- US DST is already in effect (PDT/EDT differences are in play). EU transitions to CEST on 2026-03-29, so times next week (Mar 23–27) are CET (UTC+1).
- We'll aim for a 45 + 15 structure and include a short intro from our VP of Product if available. Tentative Redwood attendees: me (Marissa), Jonas (solutions engineer), and Ben (sales lead). I can escalate to bring Vivek if you need executive-level approval.

Option A — Morning US / Afternoon EU / Evening APAC
- 08:30 PDT (15:30 CET / 23:30 JST) — NOTE: this is late for JST, below Sato's preferred evening window but sometimes tolerated for APAC execs.

Option B — Mid US / Late EU / Overnight APAC
- 11:00 PDT (20:00 CET / 04:00 JST) — bad for APAC daytime; not ideal.

Option C — Early US / Late EU / Evening APAC (recommended)
- 07:30 PDT (16:30 CET / 00:30 JST) — still late for JST.

Given the constraints, the best compromise for all three regions is to schedule near EU late afternoon which hits early morning US or late evening APAC. To make this concrete, here are three specific date/times (UTC shown first):
- Slot 1: 2026-03-25 15:30 UTC — converts to 08:30 PDT / 16:30 CET / 00:30 JST (Mar 26)
- Slot 2: 2026-03-25 18:00 UTC — converts to 11:00 PDT / 19:00 CET / 03:00 JST (Mar 26)
- Slot 3: 2026-03-26 14:00 UTC — converts to 07:00 PDT / 15:00 CET / 23:00 JST (Mar 26)

My recommendation: Slot 1 or Slot 3 to keep it within reasonable hours for the APAC lead (Slot 3 hits 23:00 JST which is late but still acceptable; Slot 1 is 00:30 JST and may be too late).

I'll check with Jonas and Ben and confirm availability — can you indicate which of these your execs/leads can attend, or propose alternatives?
